podcast.body: Originally featured on the *Love Your Ground* EP, this song was re-recorded for the *Sigh No More* album at the suggestion of producer Marcus Draves. It was almost omitted from the album but Winston Marshall insisted on its inclusion. Released as the first single on August 11, 2009, it initially had limited chart impact but has since sold over three million digital copies. Marcus Mumford states its genesis is rooted in a personal story he is not proud of, though it appears to be inspired by Alexander Hamilton. "Little Lion Man became the first single released on August 11, 2009."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This song was the first single released from Mumford & Sons' debut album, "Sigh No More," in October 2009. The band's considerable success with this track and album helped to establish a new direction for acoustic-based or acoustic-tinged alt-rock in the 2010s. "Little Lion Man, the first thing we heard from Mumford & Sons."
